name: Cú Chulainn
source:
A demigod hero in Celtic mythology. He is a young knight (boy) with beautiful features who is courted by many women.

When he gets into a fight, his beauty is instantly transformed into a monster-like appearance. He is unusually strong, and can manipulate the magic spear “Gaebulg” at will.

Despite his beauty and lovely appearance, he also has a cruel side due to his young age, as demons eat away at his heart.
